item.title: Overgrown vegetarian, 18th September
item.description:
To whom it may concern. I am a tenant of 26A Charlton Road N9 8EJ. Enfield Council is doing nothing and complaints are going on heard. I live in a flat on the top second floor which has become very annoying. I have a fear of spiders and this situation is really causing me to have stressful episodes and panic attacks. My neighbours have been complaining to the council of Enfield in regards to the overgrown Vegstation outside our property covering the window their windows. Truly I don't know what the he'll they have been doing throughout the months while the vegetation is still growing. I am not sure how this even happened as I am upstairs last window but I can see it coming up to my window and already I am scared as this is taking a toll on my mental health. Both flats are now affected my flat Charlton Road is the first picture. Covering windows on the grown floor stopping ventilation and starting to cover the second floor where their is children and moving up to the top floor. I can see this is now becoming a distraction to others and I am so embarrassed. They have ignored emails and not taking the seriousness of this problem. I am not sure what to do so I have sent evidence maybe this will support us move things along. Sincerely Zu'Wena Campbell

Nearest address to the pin placed on the map (from OS Places API): Dartford Avenue, Edmonton
